title: Junior Selection Committee Minutes Released by BAI
indian_angle: This news directly impacts the future of Indian junior badminton players through official selection committee decisions.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the minutes from its latest Junior Selection Committee meeting, outlining decisions crucial for young talent.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The formation of this committee provides a dedicated platform for Indian badminton players to voice their concerns and contribute to policy-making.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, designed to give players a stronger voice in the sport's governance.

title: Junior World Championships Coaching Camp Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships, aiming for strong international performances.
summary: India's junior badminton squad is currently undergoing an intensive national coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Advanced Coaches Course Concludes in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course enhances the skills of Indian badminton coaches, directly contributing to the development of future Indian players.
summary: The BAI Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course, held across NCE Guwahati and Raipur, successfully concluded on September 23rd, upskilling numerous Indian badminton coaches.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change will impact how junior players compete and strategize in Indian domestic badminton, potentially influencing their development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for all U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.
